researcher_notes: Source is NYU's own official bulletin programme index (bulletins.nyu.edu/programs/), a fully server-rendered Courseleaf listing carrying every programme as a single list item with structured keyword spans for degree, level, delivery mode, career and school - so degree, level and school attribution here are NYU's own machine-readable values, not inferred from a page title. The index was fetched once on 2026-08-22; it renders each entry twice (once for the on-screen grid and once for the print/PDF list), and the duplicate was removed by canonical URL, taking the item count from 1,670 raw list items to 835 distinct programmes, of which 428 are undergraduate. Every programme has its own genuine per-programme bulletin URL under its OWN school's path - the school is part of the URL - and all were independently probed for HTTP status. NYU's 202 undergraduate MINORS are deliberately excluded from this batch: a minor is not a programme a student applies to.
